2 // Two of an event's five fields are CLOCKS, which ch01 established:
3 // et = event time, when it happened · pt = processing time, when we saw it
4 // v = the value being summed · key = which stream it belongs to
5 type Event { id, key, et, pt, v }
6 // primitive: EVENTS — the book's 9 events, in PROCESSING order (tools/stream_seed.js).
7 // EVENTS[7] = (id 7, key "b", et 50, pt 280, v 4) <- the late one
8 // primitive: NONE — no value. Distinct from a value of 0.
9 // primitive: WIN — the fixed window width, in seconds of event time. WIN = 120
10 // primitive: LAG — the watermark's assumed worst-case skew. LAG = 60
11 // primitive: W0 — the window this chapter specifies. W0 = 0 ([12:00, 12:02))
12 // primitive: winOf(et) — the START of the WIN-second event-time window holding et.
14 // primitive: sum(ids) — total v over those event ids.
16 // primitive: append(xs, x) — xs with x added at the end. append([1], 2) = [1,2]
21 // primitive: PERIOD — the early trigger's firing interval. PERIOD = 60
22 // primitive: ALLOWED — allowed lateness, in seconds of event time. ALLOWED = 81
23 // primitive: watermarkAfter(i) — the completeness claim after event i: the
24 // highest event time seen through i, minus LAG.
27 // function: onTimeDue(i) — has the watermark passed the window end yet?
34 // function: stillOpen(i) — is the window's STATE still held? This is the only
35 // thing that decides whether a straggler can change the answer.
42 // function: feed(st, e, i) — one arriving event, through all three triggers.
43 // feed(st, EVENTS[4], 4) appends an ON-TIME pane of 15
44 // feed(st, EVENTS[7], 7) appends a LATE pane of 19
47 if (st.open == false) { return st } // dropped: too late
49 if (e.pt % PERIOD == 0) { st.panes = append(st.panes, Pane(e.pt, sum(st.ids), "EARLY")) }
56 // function: main() — THE CALLER: replay the stream into one window's state.
